name: re-octroi-producer-registration-and-returns
description: Réunion octroi de mer reference for local producers, covering the production-turnover test, partial-year threshold, following-year liability, customs identification, quarterly nil returns, invoice details and accounting separation. Distinguishes the producer threshold from import taxation and total business turnover. Uses the July 2025 customs circular and its statutory annexes, with a separately retrieved 2026 amendment to the production definition. Includes threshold examples and records the outstanding current-law and regional-tariff checks. This source-cited draft is not accountant-attested, is not a complete Réunion tax pack and does not establish current product rates or exemption eligibility.
